scene_sentence: For us, kissing's an opening act.
scene_translation_zh: 对我们来说，接吻只是暖场。
everyday_example: The workshop was only the opening act of the conference.
everyday_translation_zh: 这场工作坊只是会议的序幕。

scene_sentence: Like the comedian you have to sit through.
scene_translation_zh: 就像你不得不耐着性子看完的喜剧演员。
everyday_example: I sat through a three-hour presentation.
everyday_translation_zh: 我耐着性子听完了三小时的演讲。

definition_zh: 在拥堵车流中艰难前行
scene_sentence: We're in the car, fighting traffic, just trying to stay awake.
scene_translation_zh: 我们在车里堵着，只想努力保持清醒。
everyday_example: I fight traffic every morning on my commute.
everyday_translation_zh: 我每天早上通勤都要遭遇堵车。

scene_sentence: Word of advice: Bring back the comedian.
scene_translation_zh: 给你个建议：让喜剧演员回来。
everyday_example: A word of advice: back up your files first.
everyday_translation_zh: 给你一句忠告：先备份文件。

scene_sentence: Bring back the comedian.
scene_translation_zh: 让喜剧演员回来。
everyday_example: This song brings back old memories.
everyday_translation_zh: 这首歌勾起了往日回忆。

scene_sentence: Well, she has issues.
scene_translation_zh: 她有些问题。
everyday_example: The printer is having issues again.
everyday_translation_zh: 打印机又出问题了。

definition_zh: 稍后赶上某人；了解近况
scene_sentence: I'll catch up with you in the Ice Age.
scene_translation_zh: 冰河时代见，我再来找你。
everyday_example: I'll catch up with you after the meeting.
everyday_translation_zh: 会后我再来找你。

scene_sentence: In here, anyone who stands erect.
scene_translation_zh: 在这里，任何能直立的人都显得不错。
everyday_example: The sculpture has stood erect for centuries.
everyday_translation_zh: 这座雕像直立了几个世纪。

scene_sentence: She didn't leave in such a hurry after all.
scene_translation_zh: 看来她当时并没有那么急着离开。
everyday_example: I left in a hurry and forgot my charger.
everyday_translation_zh: 我匆忙离开，忘带充电器了。

scene_sentence: So I balled it up and now I wish I was dead.
scene_translation_zh: 于是我把它揉成团，现在后悔死了。
everyday_example: He balled up the receipt and threw it away.
everyday_translation_zh: 他把收据揉成团扔掉了。

definition_zh: 给某人留下攻击自己的把柄
scene_sentence: I just don't wanna give them any more ammunition.
scene_translation_zh: 我只是不想再给他们任何把柄。
everyday_example: Don't give your critics more ammunition.
everyday_translation_zh: 别再给批评者留下把柄。

definition_zh: 在某人眼中永远不会错
scene_sentence: My parents think Ross can do no wrong.
scene_translation_zh: 我父母觉得罗斯做什么都不会错。
everyday_example: In his manager's eyes, he can do no wrong.
everyday_translation_zh: 在经理眼里，他做什么都对。

scene_sentence: Like I wasn't dreading tomorrow enough.
scene_translation_zh: 好像我还不够害怕明天似的。
everyday_example: I'm dreading the conversation with my boss.
everyday_translation_zh: 我很害怕和老板进行那场谈话。

definition_zh: 把某事拿给某人过目或征求意见
scene_sentence: Any diamond ring we find, we'll run it by you.
scene_translation_zh: 我们找到任何钻戒都会拿给你确认。
everyday_example: Let me run the proposal by the team.
everyday_translation_zh: 让我把提案拿给团队过目。

definition_zh: 让人从更合理的角度看事情
scene_sentence: That puts that whole pillow thing in perspective.
scene_translation_zh: 这让枕头那件事显得没那么严重了。
everyday_example: The accident put my daily worries in perspective.
everyday_translation_zh: 那场事故让我重新看待日常烦恼。

definition_zh: 在某件事中扮演某种角色
scene_sentence: How do you fit into this whole thing?
scene_translation_zh: 你在整件事中是什么位置？
everyday_example: Where does this feature fit into the roadmap?
everyday_translation_zh: 这个功能在路线图中处于什么位置？

scene_sentence: It's totally up to me.
scene_translation_zh: 这完全由我决定。
everyday_example: The final choice is up to you.
everyday_translation_zh: 最终选择由你决定。

scene_sentence: It might take the heat off of me.
scene_translation_zh: 这也许能替我转移火力。
everyday_example: The good news took some heat off the team.
everyday_translation_zh: 这个好消息替团队减轻了一些压力。

scene_sentence: The big Lugwin had a thing for you.
scene_translation_zh: 老卢格温当时对你有意思。
everyday_example: I've always had a thing for old bookstores.
everyday_translation_zh: 我一直很喜欢老书店。

definition_zh: 迅速抓住并执着于某个想法
scene_sentence: He latches on.
scene_translation_zh: 他会抓住这点不放。
everyday_example: The audience latched on to the new phrase.
everyday_translation_zh: 观众很快就接受了这个新说法。

scene_sentence: Did you plan to bring up the baby/lesbian thing?
scene_translation_zh: 你打算提起孩子和女同性恋这件事吗？
everyday_example: I didn't want to bring up money at dinner.
everyday_translation_zh: 我不想在晚餐时提钱。

definition_zh: 在婚礼现场抛弃未婚伴侣
scene_sentence: At least she had the chance to leave a man at the altar.
scene_translation_zh: 至少她还有机会在婚礼现场甩掉一个男人。
everyday_example: He worried she might leave him at the altar.
everyday_translation_zh: 他担心她会在婚礼现场抛下他。

scene_sentence: People like Ross need to shoot for the stars.
scene_translation_zh: 像罗斯这样的人需要追求远大目标。
everyday_example: Set a bold goal and shoot for the stars.
everyday_translation_zh: 定一个大胆目标，努力追求最高成就。

scene_sentence: Others are satisfied with staying where they are.
scene_translation_zh: 另一些人满足于停留在原地。
everyday_example: I'm not satisfied with the current result.
everyday_translation_zh: 我对目前的结果不满意。

definition_zh: 事业家庭等各方面都成功
scene_sentence: I read about women trying to have it all.
scene_translation_zh: 我读到女人们努力想拥有一切。
everyday_example: Nobody truly has it all all the time.
everyday_translation_zh: 没有人能一直拥有一切。

scene_sentence: No news, no little anecdotes to share with the folks?
scene_translation_zh: 没有新闻，也没有小故事跟家里人分享吗？
everyday_example: She opened the talk with a funny anecdote.
everyday_translation_zh: 她用一则趣闻开始演讲。

scene_sentence: No little anecdotes to share with the folks?
scene_translation_zh: 没有小故事跟家里人分享吗？
everyday_example: We're visiting the folks this weekend.
everyday_translation_zh: 这周末我们要去看父母。

definition_zh: 事情是这样的；条件如下
scene_sentence: And so, well, here's the deal.
scene_translation_zh: 所以，事情是这样的。
everyday_example: Here's the deal: we finish today or cut the scope.
everyday_translation_zh: 情况是：今天做完，否则就缩小范围。

scene_sentence: She and Susan are going to raise the baby.
scene_translation_zh: 她和苏珊会一起抚养孩子。
everyday_example: They moved closer to family to raise the baby.
everyday_translation_zh: 他们搬到家人附近抚养孩子。

definition_zh: 是经验丰富的专业人士
scene_sentence: Well, you know, these people are pros.
scene_translation_zh: 这些人可是专业的。
everyday_example: Leave the setup to them; they're pros.
everyday_translation_zh: 把安装交给他们吧，他们是专业人士。

scene_sentence: They get the job done.
scene_translation_zh: 他们能把事情办好。
everyday_example: This tool isn't fancy, but it gets the job done.
everyday_translation_zh: 这个工具不花哨，但能完成任务。

definition_zh: 职位高、精力充沛且有影响力的
scene_sentence: She's this high-powered, driven, career-type.
scene_translation_zh: 她是那种强势、有冲劲的事业型女性。
everyday_example: She left a high-powered legal career.
everyday_translation_zh: 她离开了一份位高权重的法律职业。

scene_sentence: I kind of gotta clean up now.
scene_translation_zh: 我现在得收拾一下了。
everyday_example: Let's clean up before the guests arrive.
everyday_translation_zh: 客人来之前我们收拾一下吧。

scene_sentence: You may wanna steer clear of the word 'dumped.'
scene_translation_zh: 你最好避免使用“被甩”这个词。
everyday_example: Steer clear of personal questions at first.
everyday_translation_zh: 一开始要避免问私人问题。

scene_sentence: Chances are he's gonna be this broken shell of a man.
scene_translation_zh: 他很可能已经变成一个心碎的人。
everyday_example: Chances are the train will be crowded.
everyday_translation_zh: 火车很可能会很挤。

term: a broken shell of a man
definition_zh: 因打击而失去精神的人
scene_sentence: He's gonna be this broken shell of a man.
scene_translation_zh: 他会变成一个被击垮的空壳。
everyday_example: After the scandal, he seemed a broken shell of a man.
everyday_translation_zh: 丑闻后，他看起来像被彻底击垮了。

scene_sentence: Or I'll go down there, and I'll give Barry back his ring.
scene_translation_zh: 要不我去那里把戒指还给巴瑞。
everyday_example: I'll go down there and talk to reception.
everyday_translation_zh: 我去楼下和前台谈谈。

scene_sentence: I got stuck at work.
scene_translation_zh: 我被工作绊住了。
everyday_example: Sorry I'm late; I got stuck at work.
everyday_translation_zh: 抱歉迟到了，我工作上脱不开身。

scene_sentence: Is she familiar with our special situation?
scene_translation_zh: 她了解我们的特殊情况吗？
everyday_example: Are you familiar with this software?
everyday_translation_zh: 你熟悉这个软件吗？

scene_sentence: Yes, and she's very supportive.
scene_translation_zh: 是的，而且她很支持我们。
everyday_example: My manager was supportive of the change.
everyday_translation_zh: 我的经理支持这项变更。

scene_sentence: Give me a 'for instance.'
scene_translation_zh: 给我举个例子。
everyday_example: Some tasks, for instance backups, can be automated.
everyday_translation_zh: 有些任务，例如备份，可以自动化。

scene_sentence: I believe Julia's on the table?
scene_translation_zh: 我想朱莉娅这个名字还可以讨论吧？
everyday_example: Several options are still on the table.
everyday_translation_zh: 还有几个方案可以考虑。

scene_sentence: Things change. Roll with the punches.
scene_translation_zh: 事情会变，要随机应变。
everyday_example: Freelancers learn to roll with the punches.
everyday_translation_zh: 自由职业者会学着灵活应对变化。

scene_sentence: So, what have you been up to?
scene_translation_zh: 所以，你最近在忙什么？
everyday_example: What have you been up to lately?
everyday_translation_zh: 你最近都在忙什么？

scene_sentence: Like she'd settle for that.
scene_translation_zh: 她才不会将就那个。
everyday_example: Don't settle for a plan that solves half the problem.
everyday_translation_zh: 不要勉强接受只能解决一半问题的方案。

scene_sentence: I guess this belongs to you.
scene_translation_zh: 我想这个属于你。
everyday_example: Does this umbrella belong to anyone here?
everyday_translation_zh: 这把伞是在座哪位的吗？

scene_sentence: That was a cheap shot, but I feel so much better now!
scene_translation_zh: 那话挺损的，不过我现在舒服多了！
everyday_example: Commenting on her accent was a cheap shot.
everyday_translation_zh: 拿她的口音说事是很不厚道的攻击。

scene_sentence: If everything works out.
scene_translation_zh: 如果一切顺利。
everyday_example: I hope everything works out for you.
everyday_translation_zh: 希望你一切顺利。

scene_sentence: Are you welling up?
scene_translation_zh: 你眼眶湿了吗？
everyday_example: Her eyes welled up when she heard the news.
everyday_translation_zh: 她听到消息时眼里涌出了泪水。

definition_zh: 如愿以偿，让事情按自己的意愿发展
scene_sentence: He gets his way.
scene_translation_zh: 他如愿了。
everyday_example: He sulks whenever he doesn't get his way.
everyday_translation_zh: 事情不顺他的意时，他就闷闷不乐。
